extraction_method: Reproduced the 20260904 scrape method: same private JSON API (POST /api/leaderboard {arenaType, category, variationName, inputModality?}; GET /api/leaderboard/judge-scores; POST /api/leaderboard/llm-scores; GET /api/registry) on https://www.designarena.ai/leaderboard. A dedicated page was opened at pageId 10 (isolatedContext=design-arena-rescrape-20260906) in a browser session shared with nine other rescrape agents. Page-selection contention was again present: three select_page->evaluate_script pairs landed on other agents' pages (artificialanalysis.ai/leaderboards/models, benchlm.ai, arena.ai/leaderboard). Every one was caught by an href guard that throws rather than returning an error object, so no foreign payload was written to disk. No page was navigated, hijacked or closed that this agent did not open. The full 40-endpoint sweep (33 populated categories + 7 known-empty categories) plus judge-scores, llm-scores and registry was executed via Node fetch in Bash, the fallback already accepted in the 20260903 and 20260904 meta.json.
notes: Node-fetch/browser cross-check: models/allcategories was fetched BOTH through the page's own fetch() inside evaluate_script on the confirmed designarena.ai page AND through Node fetch in Bash. Both returned status 200, count 163, metadata.lastUpdateTime 2026-09-06T14:26:15.056498+00:00, totalVotes 1496427, and an identical top-5 (kimi-k3 elo 1392 / muse-spark-1.3 1359 / gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh 1351 / claude-fable-5-1 1345 / claude-opus-5 1340, with matching wins/losses/battles/winRate/btStdErr). The payloads match, so the bulk Node sweep is trusted.

raw.json holds untouched API payloads keyed by "<arenaType>/<category>[/<inputModality>]", plus the full /api/registry (model display names, providers, pricing) and the judge-scores / llm-scores payloads.

raw.json ADDITION vs 20260904: the 7 persistently-empty categories are now stored as keys with their real empty payloads (data: []), instead of being dropped. This is evidence that the sweep happened, not new data. They contribute 0 rows to normalized.json, so row_count stays comparable with 20260904.

All 7 persistently-empty categories were swept and every one returned HTTP 200 with success:true and data: [] -- models/music, models/sts, models/worldmodel, agents/agon_dataviz, agents/agentic_3d, agents/fullstack_gamedev, agents/agon_html. Still empty, no change since 20260904.

Elo is the site metric; battles map to votes; winRate is a percentage (0-100). btStdErr is the Bradley-Terry standard error the API returns. Unlike 20260904, when it came back null across the board, today it is populated on essentially every row (e.g. kimi-k3 models/allcategories btStdErr 4.9108). Passed through as-is, not fabricated.
inputModality variants are distinct site leaderboards: models/website/image = Image-to-HTML, models/website/video = Video-to-Website, agents/agon_webapps/image = Image-to-Webapp.

cost_usd is not published as a single number by the site; /api/registry gives per-1M-token text pricing, emitted as cost_usd_input_per_1m_tokens / cost_usd_output_per_1m_tokens only where present. Nothing blended or estimated. Image/video/per-second pricing in the registry is not mapped onto these two fields.
context_window is not exposed anywhere on the site, so it is omitted from every record.
date is the per-category metadata.lastUpdateTime returned by the API. llm-scores has no metadata block, so its records carry no date, same as 20260904.

Category-discovery sweep, two independent methods, no new category found. (1) Every arenas entry across all 495 registry models was collected and diffed against the known 40; three names appeared that are not in the known set -- builders/native-android, agents/webapps, models/imagetohtml -- and all three were probed directly and REJECTED by the API with 400 "Invalid category". They are stale labels in the registry, not endpoints. builders/nativeandroid, builders/android and models/videotowebsite were probed as spelling variants and also returned 400. (2) The leaderboard page's own nav was read in the browser: 37 /leaderboard links, byte-for-byte the same 37 as 20260904, all mapping onto already-known categories.
Only variationName "public" appears in the client code; no other variation was requested.
No login, no voting, no CAPTCHA; nothing was blocked. All 43 requests returned HTTP 200.

GPT-6 Astra (model_id gpt-6-astra) is NEW in /api/registry today and has ZERO leaderboard rows. Registry entry: provider openai, active:false, vision:true, inputModalities [text, image], arenas.models [website, gamedev, 3d, dataviz, uicomponent, svg, ascii], pricing input $10.00 / output $50.00 / cachedInput $1.00 / cacheWrite $12.50 per 1M tokens. It is absent from all 33 populated category payloads and from llm-scores. This is the announced-but-not-yet-voted-on state: the registry entry is real, the leaderboard absence is real, and the two are reported separately here.

It held 15 rows on 20260904 (models/allcategories, website, uicomponent, gamedev, dataviz, 3d, website/image, svg, ascii and agents/agon_webapps, agon_webapps/image, agentic_gamedev, nativeapps, agon_slides, agon_slides_html); all 15 are gone. Net effect on row_count is +4, but it is a relabel, not four fresh models.

Muse Spark 1.3 (muse-spark-1.3) has expanded hard: from 1 row on 20260904 (models/website only) to 6 rows today, adding models/allcategories (elo 1359, rank 2, 2590 battles), uicomponent, gamedev, dataviz and 3d. Still registry active:false. It is now the #2 model overall.
Gemini 3.8 Flash (gemini-3.8-flash) went from 2 rows on 20260904 to 7 today, adding models/allcategories, uicomponent, gamedev, dataviz and website/image. Still absent from llm-scores.

Duplicate display names in the registry are real and passed through unchanged: cortado and glm-5.3 both render as "GLM-5.3", and coconut and glm-5.1 both render as "GLM 5.1". model_id is the only reliable key.
71 of the 495 registry models have zero leaderboard rows anywhere. gpt-6-astra is one of them.
judge-scores was captured for completeness and holds 5 blocks (judge_fullstack, adoption, dau_curves, retention, arena_downloads). Only llm-scores is normalized into records, same as 20260904.
